# WEB-7 · Why two pages load slowly — notes so far

The home page and the case-study page are the two with the most images, and the images are large:

| Image | Size | Shown at |
|-------|------|----------|
| images/work/harbour-bakery.jpg | 4.8 MB | 640 px wide |
| images/work/northgate-library.jpg | 5.2 MB | 640 px wide |
| images/work/calder-joinery.jpg | 4.1 MB | 640 px wide |
| images/home/studio.jpg | 6.3 MB | full width |

Together that is over 20 MB on two pages, most of it never seen at full size.

**Next:** the build's image step should make smaller copies of each. It failed when I ran the build (below), so the
page timings are not measured yet. Jordan's comment on the task points at the same step.
